fields.why: 'Living with a disability' is a level of the Occupation (employment-status) variable, which the brief puts under SES, as B recorded; it is not disability framed as social position or access. A's sex entry rests on gender-identity categories, already captured as SOGI; at most a defensible extra descriptor.
B's evidence is the racial composition of one 52-patient case series, not a result assessing a difference in an outcome across race groups; the Table compares two exposure groups.

brief_issues: The brief does not say whether a case series' composition by an SPD (shares of cases by race, no outcome across groups) can count as a side-by-side groupwise entry; a rule that groupwise needs an outcome or rate per SPD group would decide it.
